inputs.text: [excited] It was 13 meters long — as long as a school bus! [quickly] Standing up, it was 3.8 meters tall — as tall as two Dads standing on each other's shoulders! And it weighed 7,000 kilos — [amazed] as heavy as an elephant and a rhino put together!
[amazed] Would it tower way over me?
[serious] By a lot. [amazed] It's one of the biggest carnivores in the whole history of dinosaurs.
